text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 903 March 15, 1976
EXCLUDING CERTAIN AREAS FROM THE OPERATION OF PROCLAMATION NO. 217 DATED
FEBRUARY 16, 1929 AND OPENING THE SAME FOR MINING PURPOSES
WHEREAS, our economic development program requires the progressive and orderly exploitation of our
mineral resources;
WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 3(o) of Commonwealth Act No. 16, the President of the Philippines issued
Executive Order No. 245 dated July 10, 1970, prescribing the procedures for mineral prospecting and
exploitation in government reservations other than mineral reservations;
WHEREAS, in accordance with Executive Order No. 245, Tirad Minerals, Inc. applied and was granted, first
a prospecting permit by the Bureau of Forestry, and subsequently, an exploration permit by the Bureau of
Mines, over a certain parcel of the Central Cordillera Forest Reservation;
WHEREAS, various investigations and exploration works caused to be undertaken by applicant Tirad
Mineral, Inc. and verified by the Bureau of Mines, revealed that the applied areas contain mineral deposits
which may be commercially exploited;
WHEREAS, applicant Tirad Minerals Inc., after having complied with the requirements under Executive
Order No. 245 now requests the exclusion of the applied area from the forest reservations;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Republic of the Philippines, by virtue
of the powers vested in me by the Constitution, do hereby decree and order that a parcel of land within the
Central Cordillera Forest Reservation established under Proclamation No. 217 dated February 16, 1929, be
excluded from the operation of said Proclamation and hereby award the development, exploitation and
utilization of the minerals therein to Tirad Minerals, Inc., subject to existing rights, if any there be, and to
existing policies, laws, rules and regulations pertinent thereto, which parcel of land is particularly described as
Beginning at Point 1, which is S 50_ 06' W, 6204.54 meters from Triangulation Station "Sicapoo",
Municipality of Dingras, Province of Ilocos Norte (latitude 18_ 00' 52.258"-30,000,00; longitude 120_
56'15.328-30,000.00); thence Due South, 3600.00 meters to Point 2; thence Due West, 4500.00 meters to
Point 3; thence Due North; 3600.00 meters to Point 4; thence due East, 4500.00 meters to Point 1; which is the
point beginning, containing an area of 1,620.00 hectares, more or less, as indicated in the attached Plan of
Boundary Survey.
Done in the City of Manila, this 15th day of March in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
